title: MODE 6: PRGM (Programming)
summary: Manage four program slots: edit, run, or delete (DEL).

body.text: PRGM opens a three-item menu over slots P1–P4 sharing 680 bytes: 1 EDIT, 2 RUN, 3 DEL. Programs use a BASIC-like language with input prompts, display pauses, branches, and loops. Formulas in ROM do not consume this RAM.
Hong Kong DSE students typically fill P1–P4 from the [[modes/prgm/example]] list (simultaneous linear, quadratic, four centres, circles, cubic, sequences).
